metadata.title: मणिपुर की सच्चाई सामने आनी अभी बाकी है? The turth of Manipur is still not our?
metadata.description: In the midst of escalating ethnic clashes in Manipur over the past three months, the Supreme Court has voiced its concerns, pointing to a breakdown of law and order in the state. Showing solidarity with the Kuki tribals of Manipur, the tribal population from other parts of the country has come forward to offer support. Recently, a delegation of women tribal leaders visited the national capital to meet with the Minister of Tribal Affairs, seeking attention and action on the dire situation in Manipur. In exclusive interviews with two of the women from this team, they shed light on the ground realities and share their perspectives on the urgent need for intervention to restore peace and stability in the troubled region.
